'Test results before changes' — an explicit baseline check before editing shared plugin.js, showing deliberate regression awareness rather than blind editing.
Recurring 'Test count' and 'All failing' pulls throughout the long horizon, quantifying progress and re-deriving the remaining-failure set against real evidence.
